history.prompt:
A single plain cream envelope with a small brass paperclip on it, resting on a warm paper-textured surface with a soft natural shadow, light from the upper left. Everything sits in the lower half of the frame; the upper 45% is empty ground. Shot straight from above. No printed or written text anywhere.

Visual style: calm, precise, premium, quiet confidence. A matte warm paper ground (#F7F5F0) with fine paper-fibre grain, one soft natural light source and a soft shadow, no gloss. Palette: warm paper, ink (#0C2027), slate, and at most ONE small gold (#F5C13A) accent, with at most a touch of muted teal. Large areas of deliberate empty negative space so text can be placed on top later. Flat, restrained, editorial. Avoid: neon, lens flare, glossy 3D blobs, cyber grids, circuit boards, rockets, light bulbs, handshakes, stock-photo people, faces, hands, fake UI, charts, and any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image.
